top_sast_rules.description: Using cookies without CSRF protection may allow malicious websites to submit requests on behalf of the user.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Find state-changing operations that lack CSRF protection mechanisms
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement CSRF tokens for all state-changing operations. Use SameSite cookie attributes and validate the Origin/Referer headers.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
top_sast_rules.description: If the id of an HTML attribute is malformed, its interpretation may be browser-dependent.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-758. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
top_sast_rules.description: Some mathematical operations on random numbers can cause bias in the results and compromise security.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Identify usage of weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithms and practices
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use modern cryptographic algorithms and proper key management. Avoid deprecated algorithms and implement proper random number generation.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)
top_sast_rules.description: Using a cryptographically weak pseudo-random number generator to generate a security-sensitive value may allow an attacker to predict what value will be generated.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use cryptographically secure random number generators (SecureRandom, os.urandom, crypto.getRandomValues) instead of predictable PRNGs.

top_sast_rules.description: Legacy category for insecure credential creation, storage, validation, or handling.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-255 credential-management password token secret credential storage rotation validation authentication-secret
top_sast_rules.remediation: Protect credentials throughout storage, validation, transport, and rotation.

top_sast_rules.description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-697 incorrect-comparison equality compare comparator mismatch canonicalization hostname url signature token partial-comparison substring
top_sast_rules.remediation: Compare canonical complete values with the intended security predicate.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Information Exposure Through Debug Log Files
top_sast_rules.description: Sensitive information is written to debug or diagnostic log files.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-534 debug-log diagnostic-log verbose-log sensitive-log password token credential secret exception stacktrace logging
top_sast_rules.remediation: Redact secrets and disable sensitive diagnostic logging.
